title: Numbers in the carnival show: chorus girls, Lee, Irma and the midway
summary: Phillips describes the chorus girls' dance numbers, the Young children's roles, Mrs. Young minding the money, and the other attractions on the midway.

story.theme_name: Medicine shows, minstrels, circuses and the black theater circuit
story.community_name: On the road with minstrel, carnival and tent shows

blocks.x: When you say "show," you mean "carnival." And when you say "band," you mean in vaudeville and dances...
Yeah.

So anyway, you were talking about that first tour, and before November you were talking about the carnival. You mentioned some of those tunes they used to play. Anything else about what was in the show? This is in the carnival
Phillips - 27
show. What kind of things were in the performance and what, if any, of the numbers do you remember?
Oh yeah, there were a lot of numbers. The girls used to dance "Way Down Yonder In New Orleans." The chorus girls used to dance.
How many chorus girls did you have?

They had about six. That was one of the numbers they danced. I just thought of that one. That's one of them that they used to dance. And they used to dance, they'd come out to... "I Want To Marry A Girl Like My Dear Old Daddy Married." [SINGS] You've heard that, haven't you?
Yeah, I think so.
They used to do that at the show.
So there were six chorus girls, right?
Yeah. They had six chorus girls...
And Lee.
Lee.
Irma.
Irma danced in the chorus.
And their mother...
She didn't do nothin' in there.
She wasn't in the carnival.
No, not in the carnival. The onliest thing she'd do was look at their money.
What was the mother's name?
Phillips - 28
Her name was... Damn, you hit me right quick. I think it was Eleanora. I only called her Mrs. Young.
She didn't play in the show; she just took care of the money.

Yeah. See, it was their show. See, what you do, when you go on them shows like that, you take the... Say if you got a dog show, you've got a strip show, or you've got a high-wire/Hawaiian(?) show, everything... It's on the midway, you see. Everything's around on the midway. You've got a rasslin' night, you've got a water show. All of that's on the carnival.
Later on, when we send that picture in to Rutgers, we'll write down on another piece of paper all the names of the people that you can remember. On all the pictures.
Oh yeah, I know everybody.
